## Checks

Local:

```powershell
./scripts/check.ps1
```

```sh
./scripts/check.sh
```

`release-ci.yml` runs on `workflow_dispatch` and on tags matching `v*.*.0`.

## Repository Layout

<!-- repolayout:9199884908051995923 -->
```text
.github/            CI workflow.
  workflows/
cmd/

Docs/               Generated books, one directory per book.
  clabok-planning/
  ui-layout-demos/
internal/           The Go packages, one directory per concern.
  apply/
  asciiui/
  badge/            Repository-fact detectors for the library badges.
  body/
  buildinfo/
  cli/              Command registry, envelopes and exit codes.
  config/
  coordinator/
  editorial/        Editorial commands for prose, regions, layouts, status and badges.
  idspace/
  jsonstrict/
  library/
  lifecycle/        Open, close, snapshots, rollback and locks.
  model/            Manifest v3, validation and the status vocabulary.
  prose/
  refs/
  render/           Pure renderers, navigation and sync.
  rollback/
  search/
  store/            Container, store layout and atomic writes.
    testdata/
  structure/        The single structure mutation path.
  temp/
Planning/           Scope documents, implementation plans and the handover.
  plans/
scripts/            CI helper scripts.
```
